question: In which state was the Forest Martyrs' Memorial inaugurated in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Forest martyrs memorial was inaugurated in **Nagaravanam, Rajamahedravaram city, Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It was built to commemorate **22 forest martyrs** who laid their lives for the **protection of the forest and wildlife**.
 
• In their memory, an audio song and a video song were released in the program.
 
• **National Forest Martyrs Day** is marked and observed every year on **September 11**.
 
• Tribute is paid to those who sacrificed their lives to protect the wildlife, forests, and jungles in India.
 
• It started in** 2013 **after the** Ministry of Environment and Forest** made the declaration.
